queries.name: all17_both_documentary_edge_roles
queries.query:
MATCH (cr:CR)-[:HAS_SOURCE_INCORPORATION_OBSERVATION]->(o:SourceCRNormativeIncorporationObservation)-[:DOCUMENTS_SPEC]->(sp:Spec)
        RETURN cr.id AS crId, cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, o.observationId AS observationId, sp.id AS specId, sp.specNumber AS specNumber
queries.SQL:
SELECT cr.id AS crId,cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber,o.observationId AS observationId,sp.id AS specId,sp.specNumber AS specNumber
        FROM rel_HAS_SOURCE_INCORPORATION_OBSERVATION a JOIN CR cr ON cr.node_id=a.src_id
        JOIN SourceCRNormativeIncorporationObservation o ON o.node_id=a.dst_id
        JOIN rel_DOCUMENTS_SPEC b ON b.src_id=o.node_id JOIN Spec sp ON sp.node_id=b.dst_id

queries.name: RAN1_P3_CQ045
queries.query:
MATCH (wi:WorkItem {workItemCode: 'NR_FeMIMO-Core'})<-[:RELATED_TO]-(cr:CR)
MATCH (res:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr)
MATCH (cr)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec)
WHERE sp.specRelease IS NULL
MATCH (cr)-[:HAS_SOURCE_INCORPORATION_OBSERVATION]->(observation:SourceCRNormativeIncorporationObservation)
      -[:DOCUMENTS_SPEC]->(sp)
WHERE observation.individualTSGStatus = 'approved'
  AND observation.normativeHistoryNewVersion IS NOT NULL
  AND trim(observation.normativeHistoryNewVersion) <> ''
RETURN DISTINCT sp.specNumber AS specNumber
queries.SQL:
SELECT DISTINCT sp.specNumber AS specNumber
        FROM WorkItem wi JOIN rel_RELATED_TO related ON related.dst_id=wi.node_id
        JOIN CR cr ON cr.node_id=related.src_id
        JOIN rel_REFERENCES ref ON ref.dst_id=cr.node_id JOIN Resolution res ON res.node_id=ref.src_id
        JOIN rel_MODIFIES md ON md.src_id=cr.node_id JOIN Spec sp ON sp.node_id=md.dst_id
        JOIN rel_HAS_SOURCE_INCORPORATION_OBSERVATION src ON src.src_id=cr.node_id
        JOIN SourceCRNormativeIncorporationObservation ob ON ob.node_id=src.dst_id
        JOIN rel_DOCUMENTS_SPEC ds ON ds.src_id=ob.node_id AND ds.dst_id=sp.node_id
        WHERE wi.workItemCode='NR_FeMIMO-Core' AND sp.specRelease IS NULL
        AND ob.individualTSGStatus='approved' AND ob.normativeHistoryNewVersion IS NOT NULL
        AND trim(ob.normativeHistoryNewVersion)<>''

scope: Seventeen documentary source observations. Every old property/edge is preserved; complete existential family evidence does not imply CR-by-CR source absence, citation-as-adoption, causal authorship or physical source completeness.
